name: Village bus stand
description: Dusty roadside stop with a tin shelter and a tea stall at the edge of the village.

name: Sharma haveli courtyard
description: Open central courtyard of the family home, with a tulsi planter and a brass lantern by the main door.

name: Sharma kitchen
description: Small smoke-darkened kitchen with a clay chulha and steel utensils.

name: Raghav Cloth House
description: Narrow cloth shop in the village market with a locked cash drawer.

name: Haveli rooftop
description: Flat roof overlooking the fields, with charpais and drying laundry.

name: Sharma fields and tubewell
description: Mustard fields around the family tubewell, Shankar's favourite spot.

name: Village branch post office
description: One-room branch post office with a counter, a weighing scale and a red letter box outside.

name: Haveli storeroom
description: Cluttered storeroom holding tin trunks, grain sacks and old ledgers.
